run_remove_questions: run the script to remove questions from commonsense_qa test dataset CSV files
run_remove_questions_custom_dataset: run the script with a custom dataset name and output directory for question removal
remove_test_questions: remove questions from test set CSV files while preserving options and answer labels
copy_non_test_splits: copy non-test dataset splits like dev and val to the output directory unchanged
create_dataset_no_questions: create a version of the dataset with questions replaced by empty strings in test files
